scope: The Old Fort of Zanzibar in Stone Town in July 2004. The model covers the crenellated coral-stone perimeter, towers, gates, and two open courtyards.

originalReview.notes: The 2004 street view shows rough gray-brown coral masonry, a tall two-tier windowed exterior and rounded crenellations above a projecting cornice.

quallaSearch.notes: Used the exact first-party Qualla original under the photographer’s native public-domain self-dedication. July 19 is from the original EXIF, consistent with the Commons description and July 2004 category.
